declarations.title: Selected Pod and ConfigMap literals have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected Pod specifications or ConfigMaps and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use an appropriate secret reference instead of embedding credential values.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in selected Kubernetes literals.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

fixture.origin: Independent exact native Kubernetes GET -> bounded collector -> engine; real pinned Kingfisher 1.4.0 and TruffleHog 3.92.5 for PASS/FAIL, native 403 for UNKNOWN. No cloud/auth/verification calls.

k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indi.public_type: array of 1-8 unique exact {cluster_id,namespace,kind:Pod|ConfigMap,name} selectors; explicit requested namespaces and exact configured cluster only
